plist/write#

Property lists written as XML or binary.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let bytes = EncodedPlist(origin: info, format: PlistFormat.xml).bytes();
let binary = EncodedPlist(origin: info, format: PlistFormat.binary).bytes();

Description#

Property lists written as XML or binary.

Output, node count and depth are bounded; a value the format cannot hold, such as a UID in XML, is UnsupportedPlistValue.
